seo-description: Explore 6b6t history since January 2022: community builds, server records, updates and events on a world that has never reset.
hero-subtitle: A Journey through Time And Chaos
hero-description: From the first block ever placed in the world, to the massive clans and projects that unite thousands of players together. Discover how 6b6t became the biggest anarchy server in the world.
timeline-subtitle: Every great player has a story worth telling
founding-description: 6b6t was born from the vision of creating a true anarchy server where players could build, destroy, and create without limitations. The first seeds of our digital world were planted.
growth-description: As word spread, builders, griefers, and explorers flocked to our world. Great bases were built, epic battles were fought, and legendary players emerged.
expansion-description: Server updates, new features, and a growing community pushed 6b6t to new heights. The world expanded, and so did our legacy.
modern-description: Today, 6b6t stands as a testament to what happens when creativity meets chaos. Our community continues to grow, build, and define what anarchy truly means.
legacy-description: Every block placed, every structure built, every friendship forged - they all contribute to the living history of 6b6t. Join us and become part of the legend.

historyHero.fromTheFirstBlocksInJanuary2022ToThe: From the first blocks in January 2022 to the builds, clans and events that shaped the world. Explore the stories left behind by the community.
historyHero.playersGatheredBeneathAnIlluminated6b6tS: Players gathered beneath an illuminated 6b6t sign and beacon beams

historyLegacy.everyMilestoneHasPeopleBehindItTheAdmini: Every milestone has people behind it. The administrators, developers and players make this world what it is.
historyLegacy.theOwnerQbastyAndAdminXymbKeptTheServer: The owner qbasty and admin Xymb kept the server online through month-long periods of low activity and limited financial support.
historyLegacy.scarxNeontonightTajinlawAndTheDevelopers: ScarX, NeonTonight, Tajinlaw and the developers behind the server’s features helped 6b6t grow to hundreds of players online without a queue.
historyLegacy.clansLikeLaggangColonizadores555AndThmHa: Clans like LagGang, Colonizadores, 555 and THM have united hundreds of players to leave their mark on the server and challenge what is possible.
